review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Summary The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for implementing, configuring, and maintaining network infrastructure across the enterprise. Key Responsibilities Deploy, configure, and maintain enterprise-grade network infrastructure across global data centers and remote sites. Maintain accurate documentation of network topology, configurations, and operational procedures. Troubleshoot complex issues involving routing, switching, firewalls, wireless systems, and connectivity between inter
eligibility_evidence: This is a hybrid position requiring an on-site presence 3 to 4 days per week.
Please note that the number of days on-site can increase based on business needs.
Troubleshoot complex issues involving routing, switching, firewalls, wireless systems, and connectivity between international locations.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role focuses on hands-on technical work including performance monitoring, issue resolution, and configuration management. Related experience may be considered in lieu of required formal education Experience 5–7 years of experience in network engineering, including configuration, troubleshooting, and support of enterprise networks. Licenses/Certifications Required Professional Industry Certifications in the area of Network infrastructure, such as CCNP, CCIE Licenses/Certifications Preferred Industry Certifications in Networking, Cyber, wireless, telecom, or other infrastructure areas Technical Skills Strong hands-on experience with Cisco routing and switching platforms (Catalyst, Nexus) Configuration and support of Cisco and/or Juniper routers and switches Network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, NetFlow, Wireshark) Firewall administration (e.g., Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Cisco ASA)
